gloss: ... and come; go and ... (and come back); has become ...; has started to ...

definitions.explanation: Attached to the te-form of a verb, くる keeps its sense of movement toward where the speaker is: {持|も}ってくる (to bring something), {連|つ}れてくる (to bring someone along), {帰|かえ}ってくる (to come back home). The verb before て says how the coming happens.

definitions.gloss: go and ...; do ... and come back
definitions.explanation: With an action done elsewhere, 〜てくる means going to do it and returning: {買|か}ってくる (to go and buy), {見|み}てくる (to go and have a look). This is the くる of {行|い}ってきます, said when leaving the house.

definitions.gloss: has become ...; has started to ... (change up to now)
definitions.explanation: With verbs of change, 〜てくる describes a change that has developed up to the present, or something that has just begun to appear: {暖|あたた}かくなってきた (it has gotten warmer), {分|わ}かってきた (I have begun to understand), {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}ってきた (it has started raining). Its mirror image is 〜ていく, which carries a change on from now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きた。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦{帰|かえ}っ→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧てくる。
examples.english: My father comes home late every night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦びっくりした→びっくりする：01178_bikkurisuru⟧。
examples.english: A big dog came running toward us, so I was startled.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}っ→買う：00489_kau⟧てくる。
⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧きます。
examples.english: I'll go and see how things are.

examples.japanese: ⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}っ→行く：00119_iku⟧てくる⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{留守番|るすばん}→留守番：15546_rusuban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the post office, so please watch the house while I'm out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{分|わ}かって→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧きました。
examples.english: Recently I've gradually begun to understand Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧になって、⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めよう→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: Night has fallen and it's gradually gotten colder, so let's close the window.

notes:
Formed from the te-form of a verb plus くる. The helper conjugates like ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: 〜てきます, 〜てきた, 〜てこ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧.

USAGE:
- Sense 1 pairs with 〜ていく: ⟦{持|も}っ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧てくる (bring) vs. ⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧ (take).
- Sense 3 looks back from now: ⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた (has been increasing), ⟦{慣|な}れて→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧きた (have gotten used to it), ⟦{眠|ねむ}く→眠い：00872_nemui⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた (I'm getting sleepy).

WATCH OUT:
- A change that continues from now on takes 〜ていく: ⟦これから→これから：01287_korekara⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧いく (it will keep increasing) vs. ⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた (it has been increasing).

WRITING:
- Usually written in kana as a helper; the kanji form ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ is common when the movement is literal (⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧).

RELATED WORDS:
- ていく: go on ...ing; change from now on
- ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come
